description:
AMYET K10 Electric Bike – Power, Range, and Performance for the Modern Rider
The AMYET K10 is engineered to deliver an unbeatable combination of power, range, and durability for adult riders seeking a high-performance electric bicycle. Whether you’re commuting to work, exploring mountain trails, cruising the beach, or running errands, the K10 is built to handle it all with ease.
At its heart lies a 1000W brushless motor (peak 1500W), providing smooth, quiet, and maintenance-free power that excels on steep hills and rough terrain. With instant torque and speeds up to 28 mph, you’ll experience effortless acceleration and confident climbing without breaking a sweat.
Powered by a 48V 15Ah removable lithium battery, the K10 offers an exceptional 35–60 mile range on a single charge—enough for most daily commutes and weekend adventures. The battery locks securely in the frame and removes quickly for indoor charging, ensuring convenience and flexibility.
Built for all-terrain versatility, the AMYET K10 features a high-tensile aluminum alloy frame, front suspension fork, and wide 20×4.0 fat tires that glide over sand, snow, mud, and pavement. Dual hydraulic disc brakes deliver superior stopping power in all weather conditions, while the 7-speed Shimano drivetrain lets you adapt to any slope or speed effortlessly.
Stay in control with the smart LCD display, which tracks speed, battery level, distance, and 5 levels of pedal assist. Integrated LED lighting ensures visibility at dawn, dusk, and night, while the adjustable seat, ergonomic grips, and sturdy rear rack add comfort and utility for every journey.
Backed by AMYET's quality assurance, the K10 arrives 90% pre-assembled for quick setup. With a focus on reliability, performance, and style, the AMYET K10 is more than an ebike—it's your ticket to freedom, efficiency, and endless adventure.
